headline: Panel Class Rework Recurrence
diagnosis: The Panel class has undergone multiple fixes and updates, particularly regarding its title and subtitle handling. The recurring theme in commit messages indicates issues with missing parameters and style attributes, leading to confusion and bugs.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the Panel class's title and subtitle handling logic to identify inconsistencies.
Standardize the handling of optional parameters in the Panel class, ensuring all are correctly documented and default values are set appropriately.
Implement comprehensive unit tests focusing on the title, subtitle, and style parameters to catch future regressions.
Establish a code review process specifically for changes to the Panel class to ensure clarity and adherence to the design.
owner_hint: Assign a dedicated owner for the Panel class to reduce bus factor.
